preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i <= 10**12 for x_i in x)
preconditions.description: Each vertex's beauty is a non-negative integer not larger than 10^12.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(f(u, v) for u in range(1, n+1) for v in range(1, n+1) if u == 1 or (u, v) in edges) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the beauties on all paths (u, v) such that u is an ancestor of v, modulo 10^9 + 7.
